terms.comment: Trust, good faith, belief; in the Church, faith in God, and the faith itself, the Christian religion (Lewis & Short). Bonā fidē, in good faith (Traupman).

phrases.latin: Fīlia, fidēs tua tē salvam fēcit: vāde in pāce
phrases.english: Daughter, your faith has made you well: go in peace

phrases.latin: Chrīstusque nōbīs sit cibus, pōtusque noster sit fidēs
phrases.english: let Christ be our food, and faith our drink
You of little faith, why did you doubt?
